description: List CFD clump information. By default, the CFD clump ID and position are listed. Use the attribute keyword to list all CFD clump attributes that can be listed.

keywords.name: attribute
keywords.description: List CFD clump attributes. If no s is given, then the available attributes are listed. If s is specified, then the value of that attribute is listed for each CFD clump. Attributes are characteristics of CFD clumps such as force and porosity.

keywords.name: elements
keywords.description: List the CFD elements to which a clump contributes.

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: List the extra variables at index i.

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: List the group names at slot s.

examples.description: List the fluid force per object

notes: Give the optional attribute name to 'list attribute' as a bare token; a quoted string errors as an unused parameter on all versions. 'list group <s>' takes a slot name, not a group name.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): list and the attribute, elements, extra and group sub-keywords executed on all three consoles.
